kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
أنحمل (form VII)
# أَنْحَمِلُ (ʔanḥamilu) /ʔan.ħa.mi.lu/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of اِنْحَمَلَ (inḥamala)
# أَنْحَمِلَ (ʔanḥamila) /ʔan.ħa.mi.la/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of اِنْحَمَلَ (inḥamala)
# أَنْحَمِلْ (ʔanḥamil) /ʔan.ħa.mil/: first-person singular non-past active jussive of اِنْحَمَلَ (inḥamala)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
